requirements.summary: Plans documentation must define one shared routing payload contract across all navigation surfaces rather than ad hoc per-surface payloads.
requirements.raw_excerpt: - define one shared routing payload contract rather than separate ad hoc payloads per surface

requirements.summary: Route activation must reconstruct scope by restoring run context, tab, filters, and inspector target instead of only opening a page.
requirements.raw_excerpt: - search result activation restores the correct scope before selecting the target

requirements.summary: Archived, removed, and deleted states must remain semantically distinct in storage and UI records.
A canonical concern record family and corresponding projection contract must be added to avoid distributed semantics.
requirements.raw_excerpt: - Add a canonical concern record family and corresponding projection contract.

requirements.summary: GitHub-facing specs must stop using mutable login names as storage keys and use stable internal account IDs instead.
requirements.raw_excerpt:
- GitHub auth still keys by `login`
- canonical contracts want stable internal `account_id`

requirements.summary: Cross-family historical semantics must be explicitly standardized as shared overlays (historical, stale_historical, superseded, revoked, reopened, archived, removed) while preserving family-local lifecycle states.
requirements.raw_excerpt:
- Define a shared historical-semantic vocabulary for cross-family overlays:
  - `historical`
  - `stale_historical`
  - `superseded`
  - `revoked`
  - `reopened`
  - `archived`
  - `removed`

requirements.summary: Requested/effective identity disclosure must be unified across graph, artifacts, GitHub/auth, and usage/account-pressure surfaces rather than modeled per-feature.
requirements.raw_excerpt:
- Define one shared requested/effective identity disclosure contract reusable across:
  - graph detail
  - artifacts
  - GitHub/auth surfaces
  - usage/account-pressure surfaces

requirements.summary: Usage and storage attribution must retire tier-first routing and treat seam, package, lane, and attempt anchors as first-class runtime dimensions.
requirements.raw_excerpt: - Rework usage/storage attribution around lane/package/seam/attempt/remediation dimensions instead of centering `tier_id`.

decisions.summary: Deep-link URLs remain human-meaningful, but their decoded payloads are normalized into the same internal routing contract as in-app navigation.
decisions.raw_excerpt:
- keep human-meaningful deep-link URLs for recovery/resume
- but normalize their decoded payload into the same routing contract used by in-app search and command routing
decisions.decision_rationale: Avoid split schemas between URL navigation and in-app routing.

decisions.summary: Concern records are explicitly separated from review findings, annotations, blocked episodes, graph patch requests, and recovery records.
decisions.raw_excerpt: - keep concern separate from review findings, annotations, blocked episodes, and recovery records while allowing rich cross-linking.
decisions.decision_rationale: Preserve durable concern identity while permitting cross-reference flows.

decisions.summary: Only the Progress surface remains widget-composed while non-Progress Orchestrator tabs shift to native view-state ownership.
decisions.raw_excerpt: - Reclassify Orchestrator surfaces so only `Progress` is widget-composed and move non-Progress tabs onto native view-state contracts.
decisions.decision_rationale: Resolve native-tab versus widget ownership drift.

data_shapes.summary: A shared destination payload shape is proposed with composable routing fields for project, run, destination surface, object identity, filters, and focus behavior.
The concern record minimum envelope defines required identity, scope, lifecycle, ownership, timestamps, and reference arrays.
Concern resolution_kind is an explicit enum and cannot be replaced by dismissal semantics.
Canonical contracts expose requested_account_policy but lack a requested-side concrete account anchor field.
data_shapes.raw_excerpt:
- canonical contracts expose `requested_account_policy`
- but not an equally canonical `requested_account_id`

data_shapes.summary: Storage and contracts need a shared governance-record template for concerns, reviews, promotions, corroboration, graph patches, and recovery records.
data_shapes.raw_excerpt: - Add a governance-record template to storage/contracts so concern/review/promotion/corroboration/graph-patch/recovery records stop emerging ad hoc.

routing_rules.summary: All Open in and Show in pivots should be thin adapters over the shared routing payload rather than feature-local semantics.
routing_rules.raw_excerpt: - all “Open in …” / “Show in …” actions should become thin wrappers over the shared routing payload

routing_rules.summary: Repeated sightings should update an existing concern using scope and lineage-aware heuristics instead of summary-only auto-merge.
routing_rules.raw_excerpt:
- repeated sightings of the same underlying issue should usually update an existing concern rather than minting endless duplicates
- do not merge automatically just because summaries look similar

routing_rules.summary: Generic page-string command payloads and tier-bound filters must be constrained during native-surface cleanup to prevent routing regressions.
routing_rules.raw_excerpt: - command payloads with generic `page: string` or tier-bound filters will quietly undermine any native-surface cleanup if they are not constrained at the same time

routing_rules.summary: Routing activation must explicitly distinguish persistent view-state updates from transient focus pivots so temporary previews do not rewrite canonical Orchestrator focus state.
routing_rules.raw_excerpt:
- some route activations should update stored view state
- others should be transient focus changes only

routing_rules.summary: When a target surface is degraded, routing must still land on a canonical fallback representation instead of failing opaque navigation.
routing_rules.raw_excerpt: - if the target surface is degraded, the route should still land on the canonical fallback representation when possible rather than fail opaque

verification_rules.summary: Contracts must reconcile remediation.resolved into one canonical resolution enum and remove conflicting alternatives.
verification_rules.raw_excerpt: - Reconcile `remediation.resolved` to one canonical resolution enum, likely the richer lineage-aware variant.

verification_rules.summary: Event table rows must be reconciled with stronger prose MUST requirements for run.started, usage.event, hitl.*, and related validation events.
verification_rules.raw_excerpt:
- Reconcile event-table rows with the richer prose MUSTs for:
  - `run.started`
  - `usage.event`
  - `hitl.*`
  - related runtime/config validation events

owner_consumer_obligations.summary: Concern ownership and blocked ownership are separate obligations and must not be conflated even when held by the same actor.
owner_consumer_obligations.raw_excerpt:
- concern owner = who is responsible for the concern
- blocked owner = who/what is currently blocking progress
- Those may overlap, but they are not the same field.

owner_consumer_obligations.summary: Concern deduplication governance requires explicit source/scope/category/lineage criteria rather than implicit text similarity.
owner_consumer_obligations.raw_excerpt: - use source/scope/category/lineage-aware heuristics or explicit governance action

owner_consumer_obligations.summary: Decision and permission docs must assign explicit authority for concern acknowledgment, promotion revocation, corroboration outcomes, and blocked-state ownership.
owner_consumer_obligations.raw_excerpt: - `Decision_Policy.md` does not yet explain who can acknowledge concerns, revoke promotions, confirm corroboration outcomes, or own blocked states under the new overseer model.

owner_consumer_obligations.summary: Concern-notification behavior must reduce reminder noise for acknowledged concerns without suppressing visibility of still-active canonical blockers.
owner_consumer_obligations.raw_excerpt:
- `acknowledged` may reduce reminder noise
- `dismissed` should suppress concern presentation but not canonical blocked episodes if those remain active

stale_retirement_items.summary: Tier-era routing and ownership assumptions are identified for retirement in favor of seam/package/lane and attempt-scoped runtime anchors.
stale_retirement_items.raw_excerpt:
- `Orchestrator_Page.md` still uses tier-era scoping in concrete table/column/widget definitions
- tighten ... around canonical runtime objects (`node_id`, `attempt_id`, `lane_id`, `seam_id`, `package_id`)

open_questions.summary: Requested-side concrete account representation is unresolved because canonical docs define policy but not a concrete requested account field.
open_questions.raw_excerpt: - canonical contracts have `requested_account_policy` but no robust requested-side concrete account anchor

open_questions.summary: Broader second-sweep reconciliation scope is still in flight and needs explicit completion criteria for closing identity and ownership deltas.
open_questions.raw_excerpt: - this Gemini cluster is an early broader-second-sweep delta; jumbo-doc section reads and later model passes are still in flight

open_questions.summary: Authority and conflict-resolution policy for contradictory upstream contract-unification outputs remains underdefined.
open_questions.raw_excerpt: - Contract unification is treated as deterministic, but the conflict-resolution authority/rules are still underdefined for contradictory upstream phase outputs.

process_defects.summary: Contracts_V0 contains a real remediation.resolved enum conflict between lineage-aware values and success/failure values.
process_defects.raw_excerpt:
- one section says resolution enum is: `fixed` `superseded` `abandoned` `replan_required`
- another section defines minimum payload resolution as: `success` `failed` `ceiling_exceeded`

process_defects.summary: Storage/contracts prose and event table rows diverge, creating an implementation trap where official rows under-specify required payloads.
process_defects.raw_excerpt: - storage/contracts often require richer snapshots in prose than they enumerate in their registered field tables
